meta.name: Cover Story
meta.notes: Black-and-white newsprint base; primary colours the masthead, stickers, sale tags and the full back-cover band; light/pastel primaries switch the masthead to black and become the hero ground instead.

issues: Scroll reveal (.rv at opacity 0) never fired in full-page renders: the home product grid, Contents index (stress + mobile) and catalog rows 13+ showed up as huge empty bands of cream, so half the page read as broken
Story cover image was lazy-loaded and rendered as an empty beige box behind the 'TM'/'NS' masthead, which killed the signature image-over-letters layering on the strongest cover

The front cropped copy (arch clip) was so wide that it ate whole letters: 'Terpstra Muziek Drumland' read as 'Dru  land' and 'Nacra Sailing' as 'Sa  ng'. The overlap trick hurt legibility instead of teasing it
Images had no cover lines: the brief asks for corner cover lines ('+ 24 new arrivals') but the image only carried a tiny 'No. 2026' tag, so it read as a hero photo, not a magazine cover
Catalog featured card: both .pc-img and .pc-body had flex:1, leaving a dead gap under the title, and a 2x2 feature near the end of the list left a hole in the grid
On mobile the image started at 38% of a 3-line masthead and buried the middle line almost completely
Light/mid brand colours (Nacra orange) give a lower-contrast masthead on cream. It still works at display size, but it's the weakest brand case
fixed: Added a fail-safe to the reveal (both pages): everything is forced to .in after 2.6s, so no cover can stay blank while the scroll-in motion still plays
Story and contact-sheet images now load eagerly with async decoding, so the story cover renders its image and the cropped front copy

Tightened the front-copy arch (19% side inset, starts lower) so letters break around the subject but the masthead stays readable. Mobile gets its own arch and pushes the image down to 50% of the masthead height

New .ph-cl corner cover line on the image: a brand-colour label chip ('Inside this issue', 'Cover story' or the brand name) over a big white Oswald '+ 4688 producten' / '+ eyebrow' line on the hero, story and catalog covers
Catalog feature card only spans 2x2 when at least 4 items follow it (no grid holes), its body no longer stretches, and the image uses contain with padding so packshots aren't cropped
